parameters.query:
SELECT s.tracking_number, s.client_token, s.last_template, s.context
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS phone) q
LEFT JOIN anteraja_chat_state s ON s.phone = q.phone

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session: 'anteraja', chatId: $('Siapkan Konteks').item.json.phone + '@c.us', text: $('Putuskan Aksi').item.json.reply_text }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO anteraja_chat_state (phone, last_message_at, context, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, now(), $2::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
  last_message_at = now(),
  context = anteraja_chat_state.context || EXCLUDED.context,
  updated_at = now()

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Siapkan Konteks').item.json.phone }},{{ JSON.stringify({ last_inbound_text: $('Normalisasi').item.json.text, last_intent: $('Putuskan Aksi').item.json.intent, last_inbound_at: $now.toISO() }) }}
